easyPrerequisites: There is a land on the battlefield.
description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {G} for each charge counter on it.
Cast Verdant Touch with buyback by paying {4}{G}.
Shantotto triggers, giving it +5/+0 until end of turn and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve Verdant Touch.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

uses.name: Empowered Autogenerator
uses.cardState: with four or more charge counters on it
